rules.change_from_v02: Explicitly interpret clinical setting as patient experiences and self-understanding before expressing it; do not globally ban learned medical terms.
own_design_not_direct_source_support: Allow learned medical terms according to case; no clinical validation of this exception.

rules.change_from_v02: Separate experience, belief and speech organization; illness label does not set all communication behaviors.
Direct question answering is conditional on the assigned organization; implement assigned speech behavior rather than always imposing tidy summaries. No bipolar flight-of-ideas examples transplanted.
Explicitly decide which interaction rules apply now; distinguish shortness, spontaneity, and withholding. Allow patient concerns without mandatory symptoms or automatic trust increase.

source_relations.E4: adopt contextual applicability only, not multistage calls
source_relations.E3: use profile/history and related disclosure; do not import CBT treatment progression or sentence caps
source_relations.E5: background architecture only; do not adopt MDD-specific global symptom withholding

rules.change_from_v03: Distinguish prior disclosure, new related information, unanswered worries, factual reconfirmation, and elaboration; retain natural repetition without fixed phrases or fixed delay.

rules.change_from_v02: Optional experimental examples default off; explicit opt-in plus author_checked, target_feature, synthetic provenance and known case fact IDs required. Semantic content and clinical appropriateness are not machine-validated.

For live v03 generation/import the author must explicitly attest that this question and required facts were reviewed. Missing annotated facts block before model invocation. This is a manual readiness gate, not semantic missing-fact detection.

background_reference_not_specific_suppor.E5: profile consistency only; does not support patient_knows, missing-fact or causal rules

rules.change_from_v02: Corrections only within patient knowledge and self-understanding; no forced disclosure of unknown clinical facts or correction of beliefs from clinician viewpoint.
rules.change_from_v03: Distinguish prior disclosure, new related information, unanswered worries, factual reconfirmation, and elaboration; retain natural repetition without fixed phrases or fixed delay.

rules.change_from_v02: Only next patient utterance; exclude original voice/nonverbal stage directions, English-only restriction and END-triggered evaluator mode.

semantic adequacy of required fact ids
